description: This file defines the 'ColumnLeft' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel. It constructs the left sidebar menu with various sections like Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, and others, incorporating dynamic menu items fetched from models and configurations.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating the admin dashboard's left sidebar menu in OpenCart.
